notes: The first asymmetric movement in the library. The right hand reaches out alone and takes the ball. The left hand then joins it, because the manual is explicit: get two hands on the ball as quick as possible. Keys carry per-hand overrides; where a hand has no override it uses the shared offsets.

keys.name: ready
keys.note: Both hands showing the arm span, as in every snatch drill.

keys.name: reach
keys.note: The catching hand goes alone. The other stays ready but does not chase.

keys.name: contact
keys.note: One hand on the ball, out in front of the shoulder.

keys.name: join
keys.note: The second hand arrives on the ball. This is the moment the manual calls for.

keys.name: pull_in
keys.note: Both hands bring the ball in together.
